prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a small, calm, very expensive wellness gift shop at the resort, the same framing as the photo (a corner of wooden wall with stepped shelves) but almost bare and minimal: warm pale timber walls, a few wide floating wooden shelves, lots of empty space. On the shelves, a handful of ordinary grey river stones, each one alone on its own small white plinth, each with a tiny neat white price card in front reading "£80". On the lowest shelf, a single plain cream ceramic mug turned so its side reads "NON-ATTACHMENT £24" in simple black lettering. High on the wall, a small elegant wooden sign reading "EXIT THROUGH GIFT SHOP". These are the only words in the picture. A potted palm in the corner, soft golden spotlights on each stone. Glossy, hushed, luxury-boutique look. No people.
